notes: r2 (2026-11-01): r1 with a KosmicKrisp build that carries highball patch 0007, every other archive the same. Encoder end barriers ask for Device visibility instead of ResourceAlias, and HB_KK_NO_UBO_ROBUST=1, which a recipe asks for, drops the bounds check on constant buffer reads. Forza Horizon 6's benchmark on a base M4 at 1080p, Very Low, FSR Quality: GPU time per frame from 26.7 ms to about 21 ms, 36 to 43 fps uncapped. A new driver build means the shader cache fills again on the first start.

r1 (2026-11-01): Forza Horizon 6's native route. Wine 11.18 with patches-arm64 through 0052, FEX 2610 with fex/patches through 0033, vkd3d-proton with renderers-arm64 through 0010, and KosmicKrisp (Mesa's Vulkan driver on Metal 4) with steamac's patches and kosmickrisp-arm64/highball in place of MoltenVK. A line of its own: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024's engine and its offers do not move until a flight has run on these patches.

The Khronos loader is engine/lib/libMoltenVK.dylib, the name winevulkan opens, and VK_DRIVER_FILES points it at the driver in renderers/kosmickrisp. Steam's browser runs without Chromium's sandbox (appDefaults): with the game's emulator switches its renderer dies at once inside the sandbox and is relaunched for good, so the sign-in window never comes (measured 2026-11-01).
Known: a burst of stalls of several seconds in all, about half a minute into the first drive of a session on a warm shader cache, cause open. Measured only on a base M4 with 32 GB.

verified.result: Installed from the public release by Highball's own engine install on a Mac mini M4 with 32 GB, with HB_KK_NO_UBO_ROBUST=1 and the recipe's other settings in an environment moved from r1. Forza Horizon 6's benchmark at 1080p, Very Low, FSR Quality, cap 30: 30 fps, GPU 1% low 40.6, 0.1% low 38.0, 1 stutter. Auto Drive for 213 s on a warm shader cache: 6400 new frames, 30.1 fps, 6349 at 2 vsyncs, no gap over 150 ms, longest 133 ms, no GPU errors. A single drive. No other Mac, no long session, and the move from r1 was made with the command line, not through Play's ask.
